question: Can an all-lawful fill on a wholly quiet source write a mark that participates in a later funded veto?
inputs: Quiet founder; parity and two fixed not-all-equal reference conventions; all allowed or minimum fills on three actual paid rounds.
forbidden_inputs: No loaded founder, manual flip, source diversion, scorer deciding a birth, or future values in the references or guard.
primary_observable: Every allowed first write, actual H payments, local six-place guard, funded joint and unary births. Missing targets remain in the launch denominator.
cheapest_meaningful_control: Keep the realized words on U and J fixed when comparing H first fills. Switch off the veto on that actual predecision state, and compare ordinary growth from the founder separately.
resource_budget: Three cuts of one three-loose source. Exact first and local second banks. Enumerate or factor exhaustive final fills.
first_executable_signal: Compare the full legal fresh bank with the minimum set at the first birth.
stop_rule: A named quiet invariant or first-write limitation, and a paid causal witness or funded obstruction under each law.
decision_or_followup_rule: Stop after the bounded causal comparison and explicit weighting.
